agent_report.summary: Fixed Issue #38: implemented a deliberate desktop layout above 1024px. Widened `.page` to 1080px above that breakpoint (360px/768px unchanged), turned `main` into a 2-column grid (Unfinished+Week side by side, Upcoming full-width alone since its form needs the room), and moved the language switcher into the header's grid to share a row with day-nav — all via CSS only, no DOM restructuring. Added 7 new Playwright tests covering every acceptance criterion (container width, single-line heading in both languages, single-line 3-word priority, add-form input+button alignment including Commitments/Deadlines, switcher/day-nav alignment plus #36 regression checks, no-scroll at 768/1024, DOM order). All 102 tests pass, DECISIONS.md documents the breakpoint/width/panel-grouping reasoning, and CI is green on PR #39.
